Dialogs.Dialog: Wanna have our lunch here？ It feels nice out.
This is a good spot for lunch, right？
Japanese food takes quite a bit of work, you know.
You worked hard on it？ Thanks. Let's dig in!
Call it home-style cooking, made by your girlfriend. Go on, try it.
Whoa! Can't beat Japanese food. Let's dig in!
How's it look？ Hope I got that restaurant taste right.
It's all my favorites! Let's dig in!
Came out pretty cute, right？ As for the taste... Well, try it and see for yourself.
A Western-style bento, huh？ Looks great. Let's eat!
It might not look like much, but it should taste like Chinese food. ...Probably.
Nice, looks super filling! Let's dig in.
Here, it's Rinko's Imperial Chinese Feast bento.
Oh, a fancy Chinese spread! Let's dig in.
Here. Looks pretty good too, doesn't it？ Hehe, if I do say so myself.
Yeah, ▲小早川＊▲, you've really gotten better.
Here, Rinko's special bento. You really are a lucky guy.
Yeah, I sure am. Looks great! Let's dig in.
So, what... do you want me to feed you or something？
Hmph. Well, just for today. Come on, say ”ahhh.”
Quit holding back already. Open your mouth. Ahhh!
...Why're you taking me so seriously？ Idiot.
Hey... I want a bite, too. You get what I mean, right？
Hehe... Doing this really makes us feel like a couple.
Just do it. Come on, hurry! Ahhh...
Look at you blushing. Never mind, then.
That was great! Five-star quality. Thanks for the meal!
Really？ Guess I'll just take the compliment... Hehe.
Phew, that was good. You could serve this at a restaurant. Thanks for the meal.
Really？ If you like it that much, it makes all the effort worth it.
That hit the spot. Thanks for making it.
Phew... I've never tasted anything like that before.
Not sure if that's a compliment or not...
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... It's still a little rough around the edges.)
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She handles it pretty smoothly.)
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She's gotten pretty good at it.)
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... As her boyfriend, it's definitely something I can brag about.)
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... Hard to believe she's still an amateur.)
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She's good enough to teach other people at this point.)
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She's on par with a top-class chef.)
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... It's like eating at a three-star restaurant.)
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... She might just be the best in the world.)
(▲小早川＊▲'s cooking... It's the greatest in human history!)
Say, what kind of food do you want next time？ I might make it for you if I'm in the mood.
I'm in the mood for Japanese.
Not sure what genre, but... ※ Unused
I'd love to have ▲料理ジャンル▲.
Oh, that's my specialty. Leave it to me.
I see. Well, I'll keep it in mind.
Going with that, huh. I'm not too confident about that one.
Hmm... I'll think about it, but don't get your hopes up at all.
Hmm, hope this place turns out to be good.
It's our first time here, after all. Let's head inside for now.
I actually like this place quite a bit.
Oh, you like it here？ Glad to hear it.
Hm？ Come on, let's go in.
Wonder what I should get today.
We pretty much know the whole menu here by now, huh.
Do you really like this place that much？ ...Well, if you're happy with it, I don't mind.
Now, now, don't be like that.
So, what are you gonna get？
Hmm, I'm starving, so everything looks good to me. Probably just my imagination, though.
Hmm, nothing's really jumping out at me...
Let's see, what should I get？
I'm getting ▲生成選択肢１▲. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
What, you're letting me pick for you？ Then... how about this？
▲生成選択肢１▲, huh. Yeah, I'll go with that.
▲生成選択肢２▲？ That sounds good. Let's call the server over.
Want to try a different style？
Wear it like when we first met.
What's that about？ Now you've got me curious...
Why don't you wear your hair like when we first met？
Huh, I wonder what the psychology behind that is. Well, I'll think about it.
What, feeling nostalgic？ I can't do that right away, though. Give me some time.
I just thought it might be nice to try changing up your hairstyle.
Huh, what a coincidence. I was just thinking of changing my hair too. So, tell me what kind of style you'd like.
I see... I would've liked to see something different, though.
I really like how your hair is now. I was hoping you'd keep it like this for a while.
Huh, well aren't you honest. Hehe, I really like my hair this way too.
Hmm... Only until I get tired of it.
About the length of your hair...
The length？ Is something about it bothering you？
Why not grow it out more？
Then that means it's fine just the way it is.
So you like it better that way. Got it, I'll think about it.
Yeah, it'd definitely look great on you.
I'll keep it in the back of my mind. ...And just leave it there.
Hey, about the accessory you're wearing today...
I just thought that hair accessory looks really nice.
I just thought those earrings really suit you.
That thing on your wrist really suits you.
That ring's nice. It really suits you.
I just thought those glasses look really good on you.
Huh... Hehe, maybe I'll stick with this for a while.
That hair accessory... I don't think it suits you.
Those earrings don't really suit you...
That thing on your wrist... It doesn't suit you.
That ring doesn't really suit you.
Glasses like those don't really suit you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Oh, really. Fine, I won't wear this anymore...
Sorry. Still, I think that's for the best.
How do you usually pick out your clothes, ▲小早川＊▲？
How about picking clothes by their shape？
You mean the silhouette？ Hmm. Like what, then？
How about a skirt？ Something girly.
Pants would be nice. They look sleek, right？
Well... showing more skin feels nice and breezy, right？
So that's what you like. A sweet girlfriend might just take you up on that request.
Hmm... So basically, you're not happy with how I look now.
Wouldn't it be fun to try picking clothes by color？
I think I like bright, cool colors. They have a fresh look.
I like subdued warm colors. They give off a relaxing vibe when we're together.
How about subdued cool colors？ I think they'd look good on you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Well, if you insist. Humoring my boyfriend is part of the job, after all.
I don't really like those kinds of colors, though.
How about picking a different style？
I'm actually a big fan of casual clothes on a girl.
Guys can't help wanting their girlfriends to dress neat and proper.
Huh？ Then what I'm wearing now is fine.
Well, yeah, I guess so. Your current style is fine.
Hmm, is that how it is？ Maybe I'll give it a try, then.
Awesome. I'll look forward to it.
Even if you say that, this is what I like wearing.
Hey, want to try calling me something else？
Depends on the name. Like what？
I'm fine with what I call you now. I'm used to it.
Don't you think ▲新主人公▲ sounds good？
...Happy now？ I mean, if you like it, fine.
I'd really like ▲新主人公▲, though...
That's actually not bad. I think I kind of like it.
Don't you think ▲新主人公▲ sounds nice？
You're right. I like the sound of that, too.
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, I was thinking of changing what I call you.
No. I'm fine with how it is now.
I think ▲生成選択肢５▲ sounds pretty good.
...Are you serious？ If so, I'm questioning your taste.
Hmm... Well... I guess that's fine.
Huh. Okay, if you really want to.
What do you think of ▲生成選択肢５▲？
Hey, are you messing with me？
What kind of hairstyle do you think would suit me？ Help me pick one.
I like it the way it is.
Oh, really. ...You're not just saying that because it's a pain, right？
I really do like it the way it is.
What kind of look should I go for？
How about picking something from around here？
Uh-huh, so this is the kind of thing you're into. Well, which one？
Don't the ones around here look pretty good？
I see. So which one of these do you like best？
I think the ones around here look nice.
Yeah, those are nice. ...Which one's your favorite, though？
I wonder if it'd suit me.
This might actually be pretty good.
Did you think about my hair length？
Isn't my hair too short for that right now？
Yeah, that's nice. Let's go with this one!
It'll definitely look great on you.
That one？ Hmm... Well, I guess it's fine.
What should I do about the color？
Make sure you pick one that actually fits the style, okay？
Have you thought about the color？
Something that suits me, okay？ You know that, right？
Pick out a color too while you're at it.
Don't pick something just for a laugh, okay？
Yeah, that might be good. Feels like I can pull it off.
Is this one... really gonna be okay？
I see. I think I've got a pretty good idea of what you like now.
I can't wait to see it.
Thank you for waiting. Please enjoy your meal.
This is a winner! It's really good, try some.
Yours looks really good. Can I have a bite？
Yeah, way better than I expected. Honestly surprised. I could practically live here.
Yeah, it was pretty good. Let's come back sometime.
I didn't really care for it... Honestly, it's not for me.
(Great. Looks like she really enjoyed it.)
(Not for her, huh... Wonder what she didn't like？)
Both the taste and the portion size were just right.
It tasted good, but the portion was a bit...
...I'm stuffed. The taste was a little questionable, but I ate it all anyway.
Well, it filled me up. Can't say much for the taste, though.
It didn't taste good, and they skimped on the portion...
It's nice and relaxing here. We should come back sometime.
I couldn't really relax in a place like this. Too bad.
The tableware and decor are just my style. I think I like this place.
This place has zero atmosphere, huh.
I hear this place is pretty popular right now.
Oh, this is actually pretty good.
Hmm, well... it's an acquired taste？
Ah... Maybe this was a mistake.
I see why it's so popular. That was really good.
That was kind of... a letdown.
